subject: What your dog's vet saw before you started
preview_text: The difference between day 1 and day 53 is embarrassing. See the before/after that changed everything.
body_paragraphs: I remember the day I looked at my dog's food bowl and felt that knot in my stomach. The guilt of overfeeding, the worry about vet bills, the shame of watching him struggle to fetch a tennis ball. That was before PupShape. Now, after 53 days on the plan, the only struggle is who gets the last treat.

Here's the embarrassing truth: before this app, I thought I was doing everything right. I was giving him 'healthy' treats, eyeballing portions, and hoping the extra weight would just melt off. It didn't. The difference between that version of me and the one today is night and day — literally, because now I have a custom meal plan that fits him perfectly. No more guessing, no more guilt.

But the real wake-up call came when I opened the Before/After photo timeline. Seeing his chunky side-by-side with his lean, happy self made me tear up. He runs faster, plays longer, and the vet says his joints are thanking me. That feature — the weight milestone tracker — is the reason I stuck with it. Every 2-pound drop felt like a win.

Open the app now and check your own timeline. You might be embarrassed by the difference too — in the best way. P.S. The average user sees a 15% drop in 8 weeks. You're already past that. Don't stop now.
